retired.ch.og.dictation.ReplayTest: the ADR-003 replay spike: decided long ago, and it wrote its results into the owner's recordings folder
retired.ch.og.dictation.SelfRotationProbeTest: what a self-rotating editor does to a take is decided by the take controller and tested on the host (TakeControllerTest, #90); the Lab run labrun.SelfRotationTrace still measures the trace

batch.ch.og.dictation.PhoneReadyTest: reads the real phone's state before every batch (unlocked, screen on, FUTO current, model and fixtures pushed); there is nothing to read on the laptop
batch.ch.og.dictation.NormalBaselineTest: Candidate A baseline parity: the real speech model and native sherpa-onnx runtime on the Pixel's CPU must give the retained outputs; neither runs on the laptop
batch.ch.og.dictation.DictionarySettingsTest: the Dictionary add sheet above the real keyboard in landscape at large text: only the phone has the real keyboard's insets; the portrait cases run on the laptop
batch.ch.og.dictation.RotationContinuityDemoTe: one rotation-continuity case through FUTO's key: a recreated hidden editor gets our panel back only because real Android honours our request; the controller decides every other order on the laptop
batch.ch.og.dictation.RotationFinishingDemoTes: one rotation-finishing case through FUTO's key: the real platform reset and recreated editor during the final decode; the controller decides every other Stop-wait boundary on the laptop

freshProcess.ch.og.dictation.ColdSettingsTest: cold Settings: a Dictionary edit in a fresh app process must not load the real model; needs a real process start and the real model
freshProcess.ch.og.dictation.HistoryProcessTest: History across process death: a real checkpoint-producer process is killed and a new process owns its checkpoint; Robolectric has one process
